items.desc: Facing the viewer, turned very slightly to the LEFT. Frame 1 of his signature panic pose: he has just realized he was wrong. items.motion: 어? 할 때마다 한 장씩 넘어간다.
items.desc: Facing the viewer, turned very slightly to the LEFT. Her signature fluster pose, frame 1 of 4. Her RIGHT index finger is held perfectly STRAIGHT and stiff like a little ruler (the other fingers curled into a fist, thumb tucked), and she uses it to trace an invisible SQUARE frame around her mouth, one side at a time. Frame 1: the straight finger stands VERTICALLY right beside the corner of her lips on the VIEWER'S LEFT side of the picture, fingertip pointing straight up, drawing the left side of the square. Lips pressed into a small tense line, eyes wide and darting behind her round glasses, eyebrows raised, a single sweat drop, the left arm down out of the way. Comically stunned, still trying to stay composed. Her face, glasses, bob hair and sage-green sweater are exactly as in attached image 2. Keep her face exactly as soft and pleasant as in her close-up (attached image 3): fair smooth skin with only a light pink blush, no red blotches, no veins, no heavy wrinkles.
